Name: Muscle Himbo Anthro Alex
Author: ArgonSol
Description:
I made the overhaul to be compatible with the Anthro Characters Continued (Link [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]HERE[/url]) portraits but with just a little bit more thickness and closer to the supposed athletic nature of the character.

This is my first ever mod and my first ever legit pixel art so I am not sure how good it is compared to the one from Anthro Characters Continued.
But, not gonna lie, I am proud of the exercise part coz dang I worked on that way too hard. XD

It was mainly based off of Bara Anthro Alex Overhaul mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/139996778]BaraEnthusiast[/url] link [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11413?tab=description]HERE[/url]

This isn't a complete overhaul since it's still missing the Beach version and I'll update it once I'm done with that part.

In order to install this you'd need to have already installed Anthro Characters Continued [b](Content Patcher Version)[/b] since you'd need to put the PNG in its folder in this directory Mods -> Anthro Characters Continued 1.5 -> assets -> Characters and replace the preexisting Alex.png
